blurb: Guests can book fishing charters targeting species like Striped Bass, Fluke, Black Sea Bass, Tautog, Mahi Mahi, Tuna, and more, with options for inshore, mid shore, offshore, and overnight trips. Pleasure cruises include visits to Tices Shoal, Island/Sandbar Adventures, Fireworks Cruises, Sunset Cruises, New York City Tours, and Romantic Excursions.
